promise: Peter Dunne to be Minister of Revenue and Associate Minister of Health outside Cabinet
made: 2008 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: Appointed in 2008 and held the roles until resigning on 7 June 2013.

promise: Government to support United Future's income-splitting legislation to first reading
made: 2008 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: The Taxation (Income-sharing Tax Credit) Bill passed its first reading 64-54 in September 2010.

promise: No sale of any part of Kiwibank or Radio New Zealand
made: 2011 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: Neither was sold; Kiwibank remains wholly state-owned and RNZ a Crown entity.

promise: Statutory limit: no more than 49% of shares in public assets sold to private interests, with limits on single-entity ownership
made: 2011 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: Under the mixed-ownership model the Crown kept 51% of Genesis, Meridian, Mighty River Power and Air New Zealand; the Solid Energy sell-down was dropped.

promise: Pass the Game Animal Council legislation to establish the Council as a statutory body
made: 2011 confidence and supply agreement with National (first sought in 2008)
detail: The Game Animal Council Bill went through Parliament in 2012-13 and the Council was established as a statutory body. (Act title 'Game Animal Council Act 2013' from general knowledge; legislation.govt.nz not fetchable from the research environment.)

made: 2011 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: The bill was reinstated but never had a second reading; income splitting was never enacted.

promise: Government discussion document investigating United Future's 'Flexi-Superannuation' proposal
made: 2011 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: Finance Minister Bill English released the discussion document in August 2013 (NZ Super from any age 60-70 at adjusted rates). Treasury later advised against proceeding and the policy itself was never adopted.

promise: Restructure the Families Commission (single commissioner, monitoring/evaluation/research functions, Families Status Report)
made: 2011 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: Families Commission Amendment Act 2014 (third reading 24 March 2014, 64-56) created Superu. Labour disestablished Superu in 2018.

promise: Support public-private partnerships for major roads, in particular Transmission Gully
detail: Transmission Gully was procured as a PPP (Wellington Gateway Partnership); construction began 8 September 2014 and it opened in 2022, later and costlier than planned.

promise: Peter Dunne to be Minister of Internal Affairs, Associate Minister of Health and Associate Minister of Conservation outside Cabinet
made: 2014 confidence and supply agreement with National
detail: Served 2014-2017; extended passport validity to 10 years and led creation of Fire and Emergency New Zealand.
